review_redaction.purpose: Reviewer-facing derived copy (decision D-EXPORT-03), not the frozen file. Observed fields (outcomes of probes, smokes and pilots, token counts, real costs, real-run dates, corrections about earlier reports, paths under runs/) are removed; every settings field is unchanged.

scope: GPT-5.6 Terra pilot: 192 calls on the 12 DeepSeek pilot items, both arms. Full collection not covered.

model.endpoint: OpenAI SDK default base URL (first-party API)

request_settings_on_the_wire.sdk_retries: max_retries=0 on the client; the runner makes one attempt per task

prompt_caching.setting: automatic, left on; nothing is sent to enable or disable it
prompt_caching.recorded: cached_input_tokens (reads) and cache_write_input_tokens (writes) on every record, priced in the local estimate
prompt_caching.researcher_note_2026-10-21: Prompt caching does not reuse responses and requires no change to the S replicates.

tariff.confirmed: 2026-10-21, by the researcher on the official pages; the values equal the snapshot. No cache-retention parameter is sent, so the standard write rate applies.
tariff.code: python/src/chapter3/first_party.py, TARIFFS[snapshot_id]; the test suite checks the two agree

cost_estimate.formula: (prompt_tokens - cached_tokens - cache_write_tokens) x input + cached_tokens x cached_input + cache_write_tokens x cache_write + completion_tokens x output
cost_estimate.no_double_count: reasoning tokens are already inside completion_tokens and are not added again
cost_estimate.use: operational budget guard (--max-usd). Not the bill.
